title: Petra and the Orbit
author: D. M. Pemberton
blurb: Gideon Underhill, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
